comments.author: @ManojsWorldmap
comments.text: Don’t forget to watch the documentary about how Bhutan forcibly expelled thousands of ethnic Nepalis from their homeland in the 1990s. Behind Bhutan’s image as the “happiest country in the world” lies a painful and heartbreaking chapter of history that many people know little about. Families were torn apart, lives were uprooted, and an entire community was forced to suffer. It’s important to remember these stories and confront the dark truths that should never be erased or forgotten.
